overview.title: From proof of concept to production-grade intelligence.
overview.description: Most organizations stall after the AI demo. Models work on sample data but fail under real-world conditions — drifting accuracy, latency problems, and governance gaps that erode trust. Forgeone closes that gap with end-to-end AI engineering: problem framing, data pipelines, model development, deployment infrastructure, and ongoing monitoring. We build AI systems your business can depend on, audit, and iterate on confidently.
highlights: LLM integration and custom AI agents for enterprise workflows

process.title: Structured for speed and accountability.
process.description: We follow a proven framework that moves AI initiatives from concept to production without the usual stalls and surprises.

steps.title: Discovery & Problem Framing
steps.description: We define the business decision your AI system supports, success metrics, failure modes, and governance requirements before writing any code.

steps.title: Data Assessment & Pipeline Design
steps.description: We evaluate data quality, availability, and freshness — then design ingestion, feature engineering, and storage pipelines that feed reliable inputs.

steps.title: Model Development & Validation
steps.description: We train, evaluate, and iterate on models with rigorous testing — including bias analysis, edge case handling, and performance benchmarking.

steps.title: Production Deployment
steps.description: We build serving infrastructure with low-latency endpoints, fallback behavior, and integration into your existing product and data systems.

steps.title: Monitor, Iterate & Scale
steps.description: We implement monitoring for accuracy drift, latency, and cost — with automated retraining triggers and dashboards for business and engineering stakeholders.

tech.title: Tools we use to build production AI.
tech.description: We select technologies based on your requirements, team capabilities, and operational constraints — not vendor preferences.

items.question: How long does it take to get an AI model into production?
items.answer: A focused vertical slice — one use case, one model, full pipeline — typically takes 8–12 weeks. Complex multi-model systems or those requiring extensive data preparation may take longer. We always deliver incremental value rather than waiting for a big-bang launch.

items.question: Do we need a large dataset to start?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We assess your data during discovery and recommend approaches accordingly — transfer learning, synthetic data augmentation, or starting with rule-based baselines while data accumulates. The key is data quality and relevance, not just volume.

items.question: How do you handle AI governance and compliance?
items.answer: We build governance into the architecture: model versioning, audit trails, bias testing, access controls, and documentation that satisfies SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements. Governance is a feature, not an afterthought.

items.question: Can you integrate AI into our existing product?
items.answer: Yes. Most of our AI work extends existing platforms rather than building standalone systems. We design APIs and serving layers that integrate cleanly with your current frontend, backend, and data infrastructure.

items.question: What happens after the model is deployed?
items.answer: We set up monitoring, retraining pipelines, and runbooks so your team can operate the system independently. We also offer ongoing MLOps support for teams that prefer a managed approach to model maintenance.
